## The reference campaign

1198 wall-clock hours, 1281 deg², 4447 fields. Captures 2.9% of the prior: 30.4% of what is left for this telescope, 11.1% of everything not yet found.

Optional extension into sky Rubin also covers, to the same marginal return: 589 h over 632 deg² for a further 0.8%.

## Distant objects

The reference campaign finds 107 TNOs, 68 of which Rubin will not have, 1.4 of those beyond 60 AU.

The same telescope spending 587 h on nothing but distant objects Rubin cannot reach would find 119 new TNOs, 2.4 of them beyond 60 AU.
